name: Warframe
notes: Verified 2026-11-07 on M4 16 GB: in-game, ~90 FPS steady on LOW graphics, ~37 FPS on MEDIUM. Started directly in DX11 via DXVK-macOS (its launcher renders blank under Wine). When the game demands an update, use Update game (or `stirredctl update warframe`): it prepares the launcher for Wine and runs it through Steam; close it when done, then play as usual.
